theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k), (∀ β : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k, IsTestForm β → IntegrableOn (fun x => (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x (β x)) R.carrier μHE[k]) ∧ ∀ (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k) (F B : Set (Euclid P)), R.Represents X → IsClosed F → (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) (F) → X ω = 0) → MeasurableSet B → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Y ω = ∫ x in R.carrier ∩ B, (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k) x) ∂μHE[k]) ∧ Y.mass = R.measure B ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) k, Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) k)) (F ∩ B) → Y ω = 0
